scope: 2015 seven-role standard Pandemic base core rules. Legacy, expansions and puzzle mechanics excluded. Introductory/Heroic base difficulty settings checked where present.
conclusion: No material rules discrepancy or gameplay-critical omission identified in the assigned summary after complete textual comparison and inspection of all eight matching booklet page images and authorized core Event-card supplements.

source_limitations: The authoritative extraction omits starting-hand numerical cells, some movement labels/text and cure-marker symbols. Matching page images and matching extraction resolved these omissions.

Matching PDFs were reviewed through supplied rendered pages and matching text extraction. All eight base-booklet page images were inspected. Only the Government Grant reproduction on page 2 of the supplemental publisher puzzle PDF supplied rules evidence; other puzzle/expansion material was excluded.

Complete Forecast wording is absent from the booklet. Six-card/return-to-top wording comes from a third-party-hosted photograph of the printed base card; publisher image corroborates identity but partially obscures wording. Both supplied image hashes and byte lengths matched provenance.

Frontmatter BGG identifier, play-time estimate, extraction/summarization dates and historical verification metadata are not established by the assigned rulebook and were not treated as evidence of rules correctness.

Overview shorthand that the Player Deck runs out and the Defeat label Player Deck empty are qualified by the explicit inability-to-draw-two-at-required-draw rule in detailed procedures and Defeat text; they do not alter the stated loss timing.
This audit assesses source correctness only. No reader assessments, answer keys, prior reviews, repair patches or external browsing were used.

independence.statement: I formed this verdict independently from the assigned summary and authorized source/provenance files. I did not consult other assessments, communicate with readers, or edit the summary.
